subject: Drone films 12 minutes of Pochettino's first Man United training session
title: The drone that saw too much

lines.vo: Eight million views for a session meant to be secret.
lines.footage: drone shot over Carrington training ground, generic cartoon insert

lines.vo: Pochettino's first United training, filmed by a drone. Top secret, now trending.
Twelve minutes of tactical drills, filmed from above. Finally, something United could not mark.
The operator apologised and took it down. Legal flight, unethical filming, they said.
Liverpool's Andoni Iraola said it should not be legal. Even rivals want drones grounded.
United will not sue this time, but may next time. Pochettino's first game is at Anfield on the twenty-second.
Your mates will never guess this. Betting tips and news at aboutfootball dot UK.

inserts.story: Two cartoon players spot the drone. One waves, the other hides behind a football. The ball rolls away and leaves him exposed. Twist: he pulls out a tiny sign reading 'Like and subscribe'.
inserts.characters: two generic cartoon players, slapstick drone, football, tiny sign

inserts.story: A cartoon coach draws a secret play on a whiteboard while a tiny drone rises behind him. He spins the board away, the drone spins with it, and he ends up twirling like a ballerina. Twist: the drone's camera shows the board was upside down all along.
inserts.characters: generic cartoon coach caricature, slapstick drone, whiteboard

inserts.story: A cartoon rival coach swings a giant butterfly net at the drone over a stadium wall. The net catches a fat pigeon, and the pigeon drags him down the street. Twist: the drone films the whole chase and gets more views than the training.
inserts.characters: generic cartoon rival coach caricature, slapstick drone, cartoon pigeon, butterfly net

facts_used: About 12 minutes of tactical drills filmed at Carrington on 19 November; reposts viewed more than eight million times (ev0028)
Operator apologised and removed the video, saying the flight was legal but filming the session was unethical (ev0028)
United do not plan legal action now, but may act if it happens again (ev0028)
Liverpool coach Andoni Iraola said such filming should not be legal (ev0028)
Pochettino's first game in charge is at Anfield on 22 November (ev0028 background)
notes: Comic: exactly 3 inserts, generic cartoon characters only, no real-person likeness, no logos. The drone operator is a private individual, so the script does not name or mock them; the 'legal flight, unethical filming' line is the operator's own reported statement. insert after_line uses 1-based line numbers. Source: ev0028. Carrington date from source.
